{{Taurus}}
Taurus 13 is the 153rd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 13th day of Taurus, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 22, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 6宮13日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 153|Chapter 153]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152173}}.
